Team,

As we finalize the Q3 audit windows, I want to align on a short, pragmatic plan to "handshake" the ISO 27001 control narratives with our FedRAMP intake so Mercury Finance and the external auditors have a clean snapshot. Key asks below — please treat these as gatekeeper decisions so engineering/stewards can prepare artifacts by the deadlines.

1) Artifact freeze window: propose we freeze production snapshots for evidence extraction on 2026-07-09 -> 2026-07-10 (48 hours). Need confirmation from infra owners.
2) Control narrative crosswalk: Aditya, can you confirm owners for the new KMS rotation evidence and provide the control-mapping spreadsheet updates by 2026-06-24? See attached template.
3) Sampling/dry-run: Marissa, request you run a dry-run extraction on a staging snapshot the week of 6/29 and flag any missing logs (retention/format issues).
4) SOC2 bridge: auditors asked for a short SOC2->FedRAMP bridge doc showing where existing SOC2 evidence satisfies FedRAMP controls; Rachel, can you draft a one-page bridge and share by 6/25?

I added Veritas on this thread so they can confirm auditor windows; Mercury Security is CC'd to flag any additional regional evidence asks. I expect a brief sync if we hit blockers; otherwise I'll consolidate action items and roll them into the compliance board.

Attachments: control-mapping-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), snapshot-instructions.md (text).

Thanks,
Evelyn
